captureNote: Digests are exact on the machine that captured them; cross-platform tolerances are documented separately as provisional.

cases.note: Exposure raises the whole ramp without clipping the sun.
Negative exposure recovers the clipped white patch.
Contrast steepens the mid-tones and leaves the patches in gamut.
Blacks digs the near-black half out of the floor.
Whites lifts the highlight band toward white.
Saturation scales every colour patch.
Vibrance protects already-saturated patches.
Warmth moves the neutral target on skin and fabric.
Positive clarity sharpens luminance without colour fringes.
Negative clarity blurs luminance only.
Vignette darkens the corners around a centred subject.
All three curve anchors move independently.
Split tone cools shadows and warms highlights.
HSL bands address green saturation, red hue and blue luminance.
cases.params: hue red +20, saturation green -60, luminance blue -30

cases.note: The warm gold look runs the 32-cube grade.
A second look proves the cube is not a no-op.
Exposure, contrast, saturation and warmth compose in pipeline order.
Grain uses CIRandomGenerator; observed repeatable on this host.
The blemish pass finds the three painted spots.
Fine-lines reduction works on the painted lines.
Tone evening replaces chroma at low frequency.
Smoothing keeps a share of pore-scale texture.
Maximum texture preservation changes how much smoothing survives.
Brightening lifts deep skin without turning it grey.
Skin finish changes the highlight roll-off.
Shine control calms the painted speculars.
Under-eye correction works inside the tear-trough mask.
Whitening lands on enamel, not lips.
Alignment fills the painted gap from neighbouring enamel.
Sclera brightening is gated to the white of the eye.
Eye detail sharpens iris and lashes, not skin.
Iris enhancement adds local contrast inside the iris.
Lash darkening stays on the lash line.
A contact-lens tint rides the iris and keeps its striations.
Lip tint is luminance-preserving within the lip polygon.
Blush sits on the cheekbone mask.
Brow definition follows the widened brow band.
Shadow lands on the lids with the brow subtracted.
Liner follows the traced upper lash line.
Contour shading follows the cheek-to-jaw hollows.
Hair dye is intersected with the person mask.
Hair shine preserves the hair's own shading.
Hair volume uses a radial bulge confined to the band.
Gloss adds a highlight inside the lip mask.
Eye size warps around each eye centre.
Nose size warps around the nose.
Nose tip is a separate control from whole-nose size.
Lip size warps around the mouth.
Cheek shaping moves the lower face beside the mouth.
Jaw width narrows the lower silhouette.
Chin length moves the chin without the jaw.
Face width narrows the whole silhouette.
Face length stretches the whole silhouette.
Feature and silhouette passes compose in one render.
Body smoothing runs on person ∩ skin pixels.
Body tone brightening uses the same person mask.
Body slim scales the subject horizontally.
Background blur falls off outside the person mask.
Background tone darkens only the surroundings.
Background saturation desaturates only the surroundings.
A solid backdrop is composited behind the subject.
Removal makes the background transparent.
Blur, tone and saturation compose in one background pass.
Three manual stamps repair the painted blemishes.
A procedural star sticker is placed on the finished picture.
Callouts are drawn over the photo at its own size.
Poster mode adds a blurred bleed around the photo.
Overlay mode writes only the lines on transparency.
A watermark is burned into the final render.
Auto Color & Light measures the portrait and applies its patch.
Auto Color & Light sees a frame with clipped white and deep shadow.
Auto Retouch reads texture, spots, lines and under-eye tone.
cases.params: auto: smooth 6.00, texturePreserve 90.10, blemish 12.52, wrinkle 16.00, skinToneEvens 6.00, eyeBrighten 16.00, eyeSharpen 6.00

cases.note: EXIF orientation 6 is baked upright: 720x480 becomes 480x720.
A 16-bit Display P3 source loads without being converted to sRGB.
Transparent source pixels survive the load.
The 1600 px source renders unchanged with zero adjustments.
A normalized top-left crop is applied before analysis.
A clockwise quarter turn is baked into the pixels.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x512, 8-bit sRGB, one synthetic face with landmarks, pores, blemishes, teeth, hair, fabric.
fixtures.necessity: Every face-masked operation needs one shared, reproducible subject.
fixtures.operations: skin, eyes, teeth, makeup, reshape, healing, global colour, stickers, analysis overlay.
fixtures.purpose: Baseline portrait for local retouch and global colour.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x512, 8-bit sRGB, deep tone, dark background, visible shadow noise.
fixtures.necessity: Colour and tone controls must not be calibrated on light skin only.
fixtures.operations: skin brightening, tone evening, under-eye, exposure, highlight/shadow, clarity.
fixtures.purpose: Deep skin tone under low-key light.

fixtures.characteristics: 768x432, 8-bit sRGB, 16:9 landscape, subject on the left, sky gradient and bokeh.
fixtures.necessity: Background and batch behaviour depends on an off-centre subject in a non-square frame.
fixtures.operations: background blur/fill/remove, watermark, person tools, crop/aspect mapping.
fixtures.purpose: Off-centre subject in a wide frame.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x512, 8-bit sRGB, line pairs, checkerboards, weave, colour patches, smooth ramp.
fixtures.necessity: Texture-preserving operations need measurable fine detail, not only skin.
fixtures.operations: clarity, sharpening, blur, saturation, HSL, grain comparison.

fixtures.characteristics: 768x384, 8-bit sRGB, vertical sky gradient, sun disc, no noise.
fixtures.necessity: Tonal operations are judged on smooth ramps where banding is visible.
fixtures.operations: exposure, levels, contrast, curves, split tone, banding checks.

fixtures.characteristics: 640x480, 8-bit sRGB, split exposure, clipped white patch, 256-step ramp, colour checker.
fixtures.necessity: Endpoint recovery and clipping behaviour need known clipped and near-black regions.
fixtures.operations: highlight recovery, shadow lift, whites/blacks, vignette, auto colour and light.
fixtures.purpose: Clipped highlights, deep shadows and a grey ramp.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x384, 8-bit sRGB, dark scene, seeded +/-18 level noise, dim highlight.
fixtures.necessity: Noise handling must be visible in a controlled, repeatable frame.
fixtures.operations: clarity, noise reduction side effects, grain, exposure lift.
fixtures.purpose: Low light with deterministic luminance noise.

fixtures.characteristics: 1600x1067, 8-bit sRGB, synthetic portrait plus detail patch.
fixtures.necessity: Radius scaling and preview/export parity require an image well above 1400 px.
fixtures.operations: load dimensions, preview/export scale, hash-only no-op; masked cases are not captured at this size.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x512, 8-bit sRGB with alpha, soft radial alpha, opaque star, semi-transparent ring.
fixtures.necessity: Alpha handling and JPEG flattening cannot be verified on opaque photos.
fixtures.operations: load alpha, PNG alpha export, JPEG flatten, background removal comparison.

fixtures.characteristics: Stored 720x480 JPEG tagged orientation 6; four coloured quadrants plus a diagonal marker.
fixtures.necessity: Camera files are commonly stored rotated; the corpus must prove the mapping.
fixtures.operations: decode, upright baking, dimension swap, quadrant mapping, export orientation tag.

fixtures.characteristics: 512x512, 16-bit PNG tagged Display P3, saturated patches and smooth ramps.
fixtures.necessity: Colour management and bit-depth behaviour need a non-sRGB, non-8-bit source.
fixtures.operations: 16-bit decode, P3 colour space preservation, 16-bit PNG export.

fixtures.characteristics: 640x480, 8-bit grayscale PNG, gradient, bars and discs.
fixtures.necessity: A grayscale source exercises a colour model the RGB fixtures cannot.
fixtures.operations: decode, grayscale colour model, export to colour formats.

grayscale.observedReason: preview render uses .RGBA8 with the source gray colour space
